summary: Go/No-Go Pre-Deployment Report - Iteration 35. Comprehensive testing of 5 key areas: advisory/blocked rules, mock/static data, timeout-crash idempotency, 1000 symbol resource consumption, and auth persistence. CONDITIONAL GO with 2 critical issues requiring attention.

critical_risks.root_cause: DELETE on user_exchange_connections violates FK constraint with pending_signals table
critical_risks.impact: HIGH - Users cannot view exchange connections
critical_risks.mitigation: Add CASCADE or SET NULL on FK, or handle deletion order properly

critical_risks.issue: Sessions expire rapidly despite JWT_EXPIRE_MINUTES=720 (12 hours)
critical_risks.root_cause: Device fingerprint/IP hash mismatch causing session_device_missing errors
critical_risks.impact: MEDIUM - Users need to re-login frequently in preview environment
critical_risks.mitigation: Review device binding logic, consider relaxing device checks for preview

medium_risks.issue: Scanner last-run returns status=empty, no fresh data generated
medium_risks.root_cause: Scanner not running automatically, requires manual trigger
medium_risks.impact: MEDIUM - Users see stale or no scanner results
medium_risks.mitigation: Enable BACKGROUND_TASK_LOOPS_ENABLED or document manual scanner run requirement

medium_risks.root_cause: Device fingerprint validation too strict across different request contexts
medium_risks.impact: MEDIUM - Token refresh fails, forcing full re-login
medium_risks.mitigation: Review device binding persistence across refresh requests

low_risks.impact: LOW - Admin cannot view live mode settings
low_risks.mitigation: Initialize default live mode config on startup

1_advisory_blocked_rules.details: Advisory-only mode confirmed - no hard non-tradeable reason codes remain. All blocking is advisory.
1_advisory_blocked_rules.go_live_impact: Safe - no automatic blocking will occur

2_mock_static_data_remnants.evidence: No mock/static/hardcoded data found in scanner service files
2_mock_static_data_remnants.details: Searched user_scanner_signal_service.py and user_scanner_signals.py - no mock data patterns found. JSON files are config/artifact files, not mock data.
2_mock_static_data_remnants.go_live_impact: Safe - no mock data will leak to production

3_real_data_freshness.evidence: Scanner last-run returns status=empty, screener returns 4 results with score=62.0
3_real_data_freshness.details: Scanner engine not running automatically. Screener has some data but scanner results are empty. BACKGROUND_TASK_LOOPS_ENABLED=false in .env
3_real_data_freshness.go_live_impact: Requires manual scanner runs or enabling background tasks

4_timeout_crash_idempotency.evidence: Idempotency handling found in execution_intent_service.py with DuplicateExecutionIntentError, rollback on line 1301
4_timeout_crash_idempotency.details: Idempotency key generation, duplicate detection, and rollback mechanisms are in place. Retry logic exists for retryable states.
4_timeout_crash_idempotency.go_live_impact: Safe - duplicate execution prevention is implemented

5_1000_symbol_resource_consumption.evidence: DB_POOL_SIZE=20, DB_MAX_OVERFLOW=40, limit parameters in queries (default 100-200)
5_1000_symbol_resource_consumption.details: Pool settings are reasonable for moderate load. Query limits prevent unbounded fetches. No explicit 1000 symbol stress test performed but architecture supports pagination.
5_1000_symbol_resource_consumption.go_live_impact: Monitor pool exhaustion under load, consider increasing pool size for 1000+ symbols

6_db_connection_pool.details: Connection pooling properly configured with pre-ping, LIFO, and rollback on return. Supabase pooler detection with adjusted settings.

7_jwt_refresh_session_persistence.evidence: Token refresh returns refresh_device_mismatch, sessions expire with session_device_missing
7_jwt_refresh_session_persistence.details: JWT settings are correct (720 min access, 10080 min refresh) but device binding causes premature session invalidation. Preview environment may have stricter device checks.
7_jwt_refresh_session_persistence.go_live_impact: Users will experience frequent re-login requirements

8_scanner_ui_stability.evidence: Previous iteration 34 confirmed all 4 pages load correctly with all controls visible
8_scanner_ui_stability.details: UserScannerPage, AdminUniverseMonitorPage load with all buttons (Scanner Çalıştır, Kaydet, Yenile, Tara) visible and enabled.

minor.issue: Returns null values for all config fields

rollout_order_recommendation: 1. FIX CRITICAL: Resolve exchange-connections FK constraint issue before deployment
2. OPTIONAL: Review device binding logic for session persistence
5. ENABLE: BACKGROUND_TASK_LOOPS_ENABLED=true for automatic scanner runs
6. MONITOR: Connection pool usage, session expiry rates

positive: NON_TRADEABLE_REASON_CODES properly empty for advisory mode
Idempotency handling implemented with duplicate detection
No mock/static data in scanner services
concerns: Device fingerprint validation may be too strict
FK constraint on pending_signals not handled during exchange connection operations

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix FK constraint issue in exchange-connections endpoint
MEDIUM: Review and relax device binding for session persistence
OPTIONAL: Enable background task loops for automatic scanner runs
context_for_next_testing_agent: Exchange connections API has FK constraint issue. Session persistence has device binding issues. Scanner requires manual runs. All UI pages load correctly.
